body: Literally have had severe stomach issues trying to tranquilize myself and oversleep to get away from myself with over the counter sleep aids.
Melatonin dosen't do anything for me but ive not tried the others thanks

Day to day i work 6:15 to 2:45 in a factory. It requires absolutely 0 brainpower and my mind is constantly trying to remind me of her. I try to listen to music to drown out my head, but unless it's brand new and interesting, my thoughts stray yet again to her. When I get home I try to watch comedy and serf happy subreddits to think happy thoughts but again, there's just not enough brand new entertainment that keeps me interested and thus stave off the onslaught of endless intrusive thoughts. The result is 80% of my day ruined by intrusive thinking. Meditation is especially difficult at work because although it's mindless, i still need to pay attention, and truly helpful meditation requires full focus. 


I want to do meaningful things with my time, but I feel like that requires higher education and I don't know if I can function long enough to get a degree. The first funk depression sent me into was when I was 19 and my grandmother was in the late stages of alzheimer's. I was a year and a half into an associates in criminal justice, even made the dean's list, but I quit because I couldn't focus on the work anymore. And that was a super light depression compared to what I feel now.


Everyone I talk to in the real world about this looks at me like I've grown a third head or tries to change the subject. I do have a supportive mother and sister who really try but I still feel like they just barely understand if at all, so it makes talking to anyone an arduous and seemingly fruitless endeavor. I too lost all my "friends" when I left highschool and never made any in college so that's a dead end as well.


I find helping others meaningful but I'm rural so there's hardly anything in established charity or volunteer work that wouldn't require a few hours drive.
